content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant the premises hereinafter referred to as the 'Property'.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._Term
content_blocks.text: The term of this lease shall commence on April 1, 2024, and shall expire on March 31, 2027, unless terminated earlier by either party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Rental_Payment
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $1,200 per month, payable on the first day of each month.
